name: Agent skills
auth: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.
fresh_home: Use fresh JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR/JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR and an empty install directory under AW_WORK.
prerequisites: review-skill/SKILL.md with YAML front matter name: review-skill, version: 1.0.0, description, followed by skill content.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR="$AW_WORK/jfrog"
export JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR="$AW_WORK/tmp"
export JFROG_CLI_REPORT_USAGE=false
jf config add aw --url "$AW_URL" --artifactory-url "$AW_URL/artifactory" --access-token "$AW_TOKEN" --interactive=false
configure.note: Runtime-only configuration. Use a shell with tracing disabled; remove AW_WORK after use. No token is part of this recipe source.

publish.note: Publish uses the indexed skills API. --skip-scan avoids invoking the separately scoped security-scanning service.

steps.code: jf agent skills publish review-skill --repo "$AW_REPO" --server-id aw --skip-scan

install.note: Resolve an exact version into the selected directory.

steps.code:
jf agent skills list --repo "$AW_REPO" --server-id aw
jf agent skills install review-skill --repo "$AW_REPO" --version 1.0.0 --path "$AW_WORK/install" --server-id aw

limitations: Only local repositories are registered. This recipe does not claim malware or policy scanning.

contains: And the files "review-skill/SKILL.md" and "install/review-skill/SKILL.md" are identical
